harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication on node1 (primary, writable), node2 and node3 (standbys), all AlmaLinux 9.6. Replication traffic is TLS-only over a self-signed cluster CA created for this task; the primary only accepts replication connections presenting a client certificate issued by that CA (hostssl + cert auth, verify-full). Falsification tests confirmed non-SSL, SSL-without-client-cert, and certs from an untrusted CA are all rejected, while CA-signed certs succeed. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), each showing a changed boot_id and full recovery of the PostgreSQL service, replication streaming/slots, TLS client-cert identity, and replicated data.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG repo and postgresql16-server/postgresql16 on node1, node2, node3
Generated a cluster CA (ca.key/ca.crt) on node1; issued server certs for node1/node2/node3 (CN+SAN) and a client cert for role 'replicator' (CN=replicator), all signed by the CA
Distributed CA cert, server certs, and replicator client cert to each node's PGDATA over cluster SSH; fixed ownership/permissions
Configured postgresql.conf on all nodes: ssl=on with ssl_cert_file/ssl_key_file/ssl_ca_file, wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots, hot_standby
Configured pg_hba.conf on node1 to accept replication only via hostssl+cert auth from node2/node3 IPs, rejecting all other replication attempts
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Started node1 as primary; created 'replicator' role, two physical replication slots, and appdb.demo table with baseline data
Ran pg_basebackup -R from node1 to node2 and node3 over verify-full TLS using the replicator client cert; wired primary_conninfo/primary_slot_name; started both as standbys
Verified live replication (insert on primary visible on both standbys) and pg_stat_ssl showing ssl=t, client_dn=/CN=replicator

Falsified security controls: sslmode=disable rejected (no encryption), sslmode=require without client cert rejected (valid client certificate required), cert signed by a rogue CA rejected (unknown ca), CA-signed cert succeeded

Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + health baseline on all nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time via 'sudo reboot', polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery (service active, replication streaming/slots re-established over TLS, data consistent) after each restart

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL installed and streaming replication configured node1(primary)->node2/node3(standbys)
evidence.summary: PG16 installed on all nodes; node1 started as primary with replicator role/slots; base backups streamed to node2/node3 which came up in recovery; inserted row on primary replicated to both standbys

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
evidence.summary: Generated CA and per-node/client certs signed by it; pg_stat_ssl confirms ssl=t and client_dn=/CN=replicator for both standby connections, both before and after node2 restart

evidence.requirement: Only accept replication connections presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA
evidence.summary: Falsification: no-SSL replication rejected ('no encryption'), SSL without client cert rejected ('valid client certificate' required), CA-signed cert succeeds, rogue self-signed cert rejected ('unknown ca')

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, changed boot identity, recovered primary + replication
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d2c97bf5...; reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; post-restart boot_id 847eeb54... (changed); primary active, not in recovery, both standbys reconnected over TLS with CA cert, new insert replicated to both standbys

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, changed boot identity, recovered standby + rejoined replication
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 18d6ac04...; reboot issued (stream closed); connection timed out mid-reboot; post-restart boot_id 5415665d... (changed); service active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, changed boot identity, recovered standby + rejoined replication
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d527ba47...; reboot issued (stream closed); connection timed out mid-reboot; post-restart boot_id 97d8792d... (changed); service active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, data intact
